spotify.label: Spotify
spotify.note: Spotify plays everything at about -14 LUFS. Peaks kept under -1 dBTP so the lossy encode stays clean.

youtube.label: YouTube
youtube.note: YouTube turns louder uploads down to about -14 LUFS, so there is no benefit in going louder.

soundcloud.label: SoundCloud
soundcloud.note: SoundCloud does not turn most tracks down, so a louder, competitive master works well. -1 dBTP avoids transcode crackle.

club.label: Club / DJ
club.note: Loud and dense for club systems and DJ sets. Use the WAV export for the booth.

apple.label: Apple Music
apple.note: Apple Music Sound Check plays at about -16 LUFS.

amazon.label: Amazon Music
amazon.note: Amazon recommends -2 dBTP for its encoders.

broadcast.label: Broadcast (EBU R128)
broadcast.note: European TV and radio loudness standard.

cd.label: CD / Loud master
cd.note: Classic loud master for CD or downloads.
